# Test fixture attribution

The impulse responses in this directory are used as golden test fixtures
(the test suite verifies the convolution engine reproduces real measured
IRs sample-exactly).

- `Lady Chapel St Albans.wav` and `Usina del Arte Symphony Hall.wav` are
  from the **Open Acoustic Impulse Response (OpenAIR) Library**,
  AudioLab, University of York — https://www.openair.hosted.york.ac.uk/ —
  licensed **CC BY 4.0** (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
  Unmodified stereo captures; redistributed here with attribution as the
  license requires.
